answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 8280 Country: India Title: as salam alay kum,iam 26 year female my father expired 8 months before and my mother wants that i should get marry but iam not getting any praposals alhumdullila i have faith in allah(s.W.T) that what ever allah(S.W.t) will do it will be for my best but my mother is heart patient so i am wooried.the money which my father saved for my marrige was in his account and after my father expired those bank people r not trasfering in my mother's account and recently the bike of my brother is also stolen i am very much worried becoz of all this problem's sometimes i feel that might be iam a big sinner.then i repent to allah(s.w.t)and think's of his mercy plz sent me any dua's acknowlegde by quran and hadith and plz pray for us and plz sent any dua for my marraige and plz do not disclose this mail on ur site and if ur sending any dua's plz sent along with zer,zaber,paesh(harkats)hoping for a reply allahafiz Question: as salam alay kum,iam 26 year female my father expired 8 months before and my mother wants that i should get marry but iam not getting any praposals alhumdullila i have faith in allah(s.W.T) that what ever allah(S.W.t) will do it will be for my best but my mother is heart patient so i am wooried.the money which my father saved for my marrige was in his account and after my father expired those bank people r not trasfering in my mother's account and recently the bike of my brother is also stolen i am very much worried becoz of all this problem's sometimes i feel that might be iam a big sinner.then i repent to allah(s.w.t)and think's of his mercy plz sent me any dua's acknowlegde by quran and hadith and plz pray for us and plz sent any dua for my marraige and plz do not disclose this mail on ur site and if ur sending any dua's plz sent along with zer,zaber,paesh(harkats)hoping for a reply allahafiz Answer ID: 8280 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1750/1641=D/1429) You should determine for marriage and look for a match, and when you find a suitable match, you should solemnize nikah and rukhsati according to the Sunnah. For finding a suitable match, you should recite the below duas 100 times each, then recite durood and do dua: يا لطيف يا ودود يا جامع You should keep reciting this: فسهل يا الهي كل صعب بحرمة سيد الأبرار سهل Also, recite the below dua hundred times with durood before and after in the morning and evening and supplicate to Allah: يا حي يا قيوم برحمتك استغيث In-sha-Allah, your troubles will go away and you will get appropriate match. We also pray for you. You should not worry and think so much. Allah Almighty will help you. You should keep away from sins and keep performing salah , doing good deeds etc as well as observing hijab. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
